capabilities: Discovers Kafka Connect connectors, topics, and infrastructure from vault config files
Builds interactive data-flow graphs with lineage and path analysis
Validates configuration with confidence, evidence, and recommended actions
Generates Mermaid diagrams and deterministic Markdown documentation
Redacts secrets and compares environment configurations
disambiguation: Not a data-model or schema designer; it maps connectors, topics, and infrastructure discovered from static configuration files.
extras: No telemetry; scans, diagrams, and history stay local. Connector export commands run in the user's terminal and the script launcher runs with desktop-account permissions. Further detail in ARCHITECTURE.md, IMPLEMENTATION_PROGRESS.md, and COMMUNITY_PLUGIN_SUBMISSION.md; optional Ko-fi funding button.
problem: Obsidian has no way to inventory, validate, or visualize Kafka Connect and data-platform configuration stored as vault files, so architecture knowledge stays scattered across configs.
summary: Local-first plugin that discovers Kafka Connect and data-platform architecture from vault config files, building inventories, flow graphs, validation, and docs.
